title: Barroso Wispr
notes: Barroso Wispr — live voice dictation for macOS and Windows: hold Left Ctrl + Left Alt/Option, speak, release, and the text is pasted where the cursor is. Streams to the Gemini Live API through Barroso Keys (bk- keys) or Google AI Studio directly. Set WISPR_API_KEY. macOS: run barroso-wispr-darwin-arm64 --install. Windows: run barroso-wispr-windows-amd64.exe --install as Administrator. https://wispr.barroso.tec.br
